svg.title: Redaction 2: the dialog shows what goes, what goes with it, and the document as it will be
svg.desc: Dialog over a computes window; the window behind shows the preview with D8 blanked.
svg.text: Q3 payments are in, see row 8.
@bob please never put the PIN here.
Preview of the document after the redaction · nothing has changed yet
D8 turns into ████ · the name BankPIN goes · everything else stays as it is
Goes with it, because it needs what you picked
Without the name it renames, ana's step no longer works. Her other work stays.
Nobody can bring it back: not you, not the server, not undo.
The document changes now: D8 shows ████, the name BankPIN goes.
Everybody sees that you redacted 4 items and when, never what
they held. How long each was stays visible.
Copies, downloads, exports and backups made before keep it.
Also tell bob and ana in the chat, and why:
A bank PIN was in the sheet. It is gone now.
1 Unticking an item takes it out and works the plan out again;
the list, the amber box and the preview follow at once.
2 The later steps that would break are named before anything happens
(D722). They cannot be unticked: leave out what they need instead.
3 The facts in words, in the danger-zone way of the server pages:
the button names the scope, there is no "OK".
If somebody works on the document while the dialog is open and the
plan changes, the dialog says so and shows the new plan (D726).
